title: Ferritin–CRP coupling does not establish improved hemoglobin prediction across two NHANES cycles
abstract: In exploratory transfer from NHANES 2007–2008 (1,258 women aged 20–49) to 2009–2010 (1,492), adding a log-ferritin × log-CRP product to flexible standard predictors increased hemoglobin MSE by 0.003962 (g/dL)^2 (0.52%). The joint source/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval was -0.004246 to 0.024512; incremental benefit was not established.
